name: infomaniak
description: Manage Infomaniak DNS, mail settings and VPS apps. Find current official guides for Manager tasks. Independent and unofficial.

interface.shortDescription: DNS, mail and VPS from chat
interface.longDescription: Connect your own Infomaniak account through private browser consent. Inspect services, manage consented DNS and mailbox settings, deploy pinned commits through your own VPS runner, and retrieve current official documentation. Each supported write has an exact preview and confirmation in your client, with browser review as the fallback. This open-source service is independent and unofficial. Client compatibility and tested workflows are listed on our website.
defaultPrompt: Show my Infomaniak services and what this connection can manage.
